prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Dallas for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” orthodontist for everyone—case complexity, location, budget, and how much direct doctor involvement you want all matter. A good starting point is **Walnut Central Orthodontics** in North Dallas: it offers both braces and Invisalign, and a third-party listing reports a 4.9-star rating from 365+ Google reviews. The office is at **9669 N Central Expy, Suite 105**; call **(214) 692-5688** to confirm current availability and details.

You could also compare **Dallas Orthodontics / Dr. Benito Benitez** in northeast Dallas, which offers braces and Invisalign and emphasizes personalized care: **8510 Abrams Rd, Suite 508**, **(469) 482-0018**.

Before choosing, book two consultations and ask who will supervise your treatment, whether your case is suitable for Invisalign, what the full fee includes (including retainers and refinements), and how emergencies are handled. You can also verify orthodontist credentials through the [American Association of Orthodontists’ locator](https://aaoinfo.org/locator/).
